batch_admission: First batch requires 60 seconds plus a 10-second reserve. Later batches require the maximum of 60 seconds, 1.25 times every observed batch elapsed time, and 1.25 times (preparation + prefill + 64 times slowest token-step seconds), plus the reserve. Whole pair batches only; estimates cannot guarantee future speed or prevent an external interruption.
batch_timing_return: 3.jsonl: packed per-batch preparation, prefill, slowest synchronized token-step, total seconds, completed pairs, admission estimate, remaining time, host peak RSS and GPU max allocated bytes
batching_assumption: An eight-row token forward costs twice a serial token forward. This GPU estimate is unmeasured; CPU timing is not used as a GPU speed estimate.

caveat: Full-checkpoint GPU numerical parity, batch memory use, speed and ext4 sync/supervisor overhead are unmeasured. Slow openings/staging can still yield a partial return with no gate verdict.

cpu_preflight.boot_batch_selfcheck: Both modes, before bulk staging: delivered merge_caches/select_cache_rows on a tiny native hybrid model in the pinned interpreter, under 1 second (execution.boot.batch_selfcheck)

real_batch.admission: after row 1 prefill p: largest k in 8,6,4,2 with 1.1*(k-1)*p + 64*0.02*p + 10 <= soft end - now; otherwise k=2 (over_budget)
real_batch.bench: out/CPU_BENCH.json: real Qwen3.5-9B architecture, random bf16 weights, pinned torch/transformers, 16 EPYC 9224 threads; vision timed once and doubled for the private depth encoder

memory.expected: bf16 checkpoint 18.8 GB plus 2.8 GB heads resident; eight-row full-attention KV about 1.3 GB at 4,730 tokens; loading transient as in the GPU job (43.3 GB host peak)

real_batch.passed_rule: merge ran, at least one decode step, and a row selection whenever rows finished at different steps, with no error; a soft-stop after these is a partial pass

cpu_preflight.tensors: meta shape proof, processor and two prompt checks, then the full bf16 step-400 checkpoint resident on CPU for batch 0

formula: base overhead + model load + 580*(per-item other + serial prefill) + sum(batch maximum opening tokens)*2*serial token seconds

gpu_memory.guard_fallback: process-tree RSS when memory.stat/current is unavailable
gpu_memory.guard_formula: max(0, memory.current - min(active_file + inactive_file, max(0, file - shmem)))

inference: D400 [27,1884] opening positions, duplicated across the two arms; group maxima account for unequal stops. Both arms assumed to open as early as D400.

interpreter_exposure.native_archives: Preserve all pinned interpreter and third-party package paths and bytes

memory_guard.fallback: process-tree RSS when memory.stat/current is unavailable
memory_guard.formula: max(0, memory.current - min(active_file + inactive_file, max(0, file - shmem)))

ordering: ORIG, REVSI for each item; four consecutive complete pairs per batch; final batch has two pairs

differences: A_M=c versus A_M=g selects the preflight/read
